s: a cosy, mismatched-vintage-furniture café on Gdańsk's main thoroughfare
w: A specialty coffee shop on busy Aleja Grunwaldzka in Wrzeszcz, easy to drive past without noticing but full of character inside -- mismatched vintage furniture, quirky posters, and a menu willing to go somewhere unexpected (espresso with cola among the options). Homemade pastries and a genuinely local, unhurried feel.
_facts: Located at Aleja Grunwaldzka 140, 80-264 Gdańsk, Wrzeszcz
Specialty coffee café known for mismatched vintage furniture and decor

s: a café-gallery on Mariacka, Gdańsk's amber-shop street
w: A café and small gallery space on Mariacka -- the picturesque, amber-jewellery-lined street running to St Mary's Church -- serving coffee to a mix of gallery-goers and Old Town regulars rather than only passing tourists. A steady, well-liked fixture on one of Gdańsk's most photographed streets.
_facts: Located at ul. Mariacka 36, 80-833 Gdańsk, Główne Miasto
Combines a café with a small gallery/exhibition space
Sits on Mariacka, a street known for amber jewellery shops and Gothic architecture

s: a Scandinavian-style café-bar in Gdańsk's Old Town
w: A café-bar on Świętego Ducha named for the Swedish coffee-break ritual, bringing Scandinavian minimalism and a fika-style unhurried pace to Gdańsk's Old Town. A calm, considered stop just off the main tourist streets.
_facts: Located at ul. Świętego Ducha 66, Gdańsk, Główne Miasto
Scandinavian-styled café-bar, named after the Swedish "fika" coffee-break tradition

s: a vegan confectionery café with at least 8 cakes on the counter every day
w: A dedicated vegan confectionery café on Wajdeloty street, open since 2015 and never with fewer than eight cakes on offer -- dairy-free cheesecakes, sugar-free fruit tarts, gluten-free options alongside coffee, local beer and juice. Pet-friendly outdoor seating on a quiet residential Wrzeszcz street.
_facts: Located at ul. Wajdeloty 22, 80-437 Gdańsk, Wrzeszcz
Keeps at least 8 cake varieties available daily, including gluten-free and sugar-free options
